candidates.verdict: not seen where it must be: not a planet

rule: A real distant body must also show in another visit where its distance and speed put it. Seen there: the highest S/N over those places is 5 or more and noise gives as much less than 5% of the time. Not seen: below that.
note: Speeds along the track use one direction per patch; for p9-033-02 it is the direction of the track near RA 60-90 deg projected here (an approximation, disclosed).
